نفترق (form VIII)
# نَفْتَرِقُ (naftariqu) /naf.ta.ri.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَقَ (iftaraqa)
# نَفْتَرِقَ (naftariqa) /naf.ta.ri.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَرَقَ (iftaraqa)
# نَفْتَرِقْ (naftariq) /naf.ta.riq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِفْتَرَقَ (iftaraqa)
